standard_prerequisites.name: Objects of the category of motives are summands of twisted motives of schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The construction of the category of motives as the Karoubian envelope of the category of correspondences, so that every object is a summand of a twisted motive of a smooth projective scheme
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the assumption from schemes to arbitrary objects, using that taking Chow groups commutes with the twist up to a shift.

standard_prerequisites.name: Chow groups as morphism groups from the unit
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma representing Chow groups as morphism groups out of the unit
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the isomorphism on Chow groups into an isomorphism of morphism groups out of the unit after tensoring with any object.

standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of left duals and the Yoneda lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that every object of the category of motives has a left dual, and the categorical lemma that a morphism inducing isomorphisms on all morphism groups is an isomorphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrades the isomorphism with the unit on the left to an isomorphism of all morphism groups and concludes by the Yoneda lemma.

core_obligations: Pass to all objects (proof lines 1330-1338): every object of the category of motives is a summand of a twisted motive of a smooth projective scheme, and the Chow groups of a twist differ from those of the untwisted object only by a shift of degrees, so the assumption implies that tensoring the morphism with any object induces an isomorphism on Chow groups.

Translate into morphism groups (proof lines 1338-1346): since Chow groups are morphism groups out of the unit, the assumption says that the map induced by the morphism on morphism groups out of the unit after tensoring with any object is an isomorphism.

Upgrade and conclude (proof lines 1346-1356): every object has a left dual, which turns the isomorphism after tensoring on the right into an isomorphism of morphism groups from an arbitrary object into the two terms; the Yoneda lemma then shows that the morphism itself is an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Reduce from schemes to arbitrary objects using the Karoubian envelope and the twist.
Convert isomorphism on Chow groups into isomorphism of morphism groups out of the unit.
Use left duals and the Yoneda lemma to conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves Manin's criterion: a morphism of motives which becomes an isomorphism on Chow groups after tensoring with the motive of every smooth projective scheme is an isomorphism (statement lines 1326-1331). The proof (proof lines 1332-1356) passes to arbitrary objects through the Karoubian envelope and the twist, translates Chow groups into morphism groups out of the unit, and concludes using left duals and the Yoneda lemma. H3: a categorical reduction written out in full.
